blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Semantic segmentation is critical for the reliable navigation and scene understanding of autonomous systems, yet its performance degrades severely in low-light environments due to noise, artifacts, colour distortion, and the loss of structural details. To address this challenge, this work introduces VesperMUSE, a unified multi-modal framework designed to achieve robust image semantic segmentation across diverse illumination conditions. The architecture addresses the light deficiency problem on multiple levels: proposing a novel physics-informed synthetic low-light adaptation algorithm, approaching Low-Light Image Enhancement (LLIE) through a thermal-guided paradigm, and finally aiming to recover the intrinsic scene details for semantic segmentation through a multi-modal fusion approach. Following enhancement, the framework dynamically integrates the primary RGB features with auxiliary thermal representations and surface normal maps highlighting geometric discontinuities and material boundaries. At the core of this integration is a highly scalable, modality-agnostic self-attention mechanism that extracts both global context and fine local features from an arbitrary number of auxiliary inputs. By combining and projecting these hierarchical multi-modal representations into a unified component, the attention module allows the network to selectively attend to relevant cross-modal cues without requiring any architectural modifications when different sensor configurations are used. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that VesperMUSE successfully recovers missing visual cues, providing a flexible, state-of-the-art (SOTA) solution for machine perception in extreme and unstructured real-world environments.
blocks.zh: 语义分解对于自主系统的可靠导航和场景理解至关重要,然而由于噪音,文物,色彩扭曲,结构细节丢失,其性能在低光环境下严重退化. 为应对这一挑战,本作引入了VesperMUSE这一统一的多模式框架,旨在实现不同照明条件的强力图像语义分解. 该架构在多层次上解决了光缺失问题:提出一种新颖的物理学知情合成低光适应算法,通过热导范式接近低光影像增强(LLIE),并最终通过多模式聚变方法来回收语义分化的内在场景细节. 增强后,框架能动态地将主RGB特征与辅助热表达和地表平面平面图相融合,突出几何不连续和材料边界. 这种整合的核心是高度可扩展、模式不可知的自觉机制,从任意数量的辅助投入中提取全球背景和精细的局部特征。 通过将这些分级的多模式表示方式合并并投影成一个统一的组件,关注模块允许网络有选择地处理相关的交叉模式提示而无需在使用不同的传感器配置时进行任何建筑修改. 广泛的评价表明,VesperMUSE成功地恢复了缺失的视觉提示,为在极端和无结构的现实世界环境中的机器感知提供了灵活而先进的(SOTA)解决方案.

blocks.en: 2.1 Synthetic Low-Light Image Adaptation
blocks.zh: 2.1 合成低光图像适应

blocks.en: The development of LLIE models has been historically hampered by the limited dataset availability and the quality of light-deficient representations. Early efforts such as the SID dataset [ 31 ] focused on capturing short-exposure raw images along with long-exposure counterparts. This was a good representation of how a LLIE dataset should look like, however it was limited in terms of the format it used: RAW. The consumer and surveillance hardware operate much more easily using conventional formats such as PNG or JPG, which also provide more efficient computational processing. Moreover, the conversion of RAW images into other encodings fails to replicate the natural noise and illumination patterns captured in the low-light conditions, the quality of the resulting data hindering the supervised learning process of LLIE models.
blocks.zh: LLIE模型的开发在历史上一直受到数据集可用性有限和光能不足表现质量的阻碍. SID数据集等早期工作[31]侧重于捕捉短曝光原始图像和长曝光对应物. 这很好地说明了LLIE数据集的外观,但是它所使用的格式有限:RAW。 消费者和监视硬件更容易使用常规格式,如PNG或JPG,它们也提供更有效的计算处理。 此外,将RAW图像转换成其他编码未能复制在低光条件下捕获的自然噪声和照明模式,由此产生的数据质量阻碍了LLIE模型的监督学习过程.

blocks.en: More recently, the problem with data limitation was fixed with the appearance of paired real-world datasets such as LOL [ 32 ] , LOL-v2 real [ 33 ] , SDSD-in/out [ 34 ] , and LOL-Blur [ 35 ] . Another field of concern, however, lies in the reliance of synthetic low-light adaptation methods. Widely-used current approaches, such as the work of Yang et al. through their LOL-v2 synthetic dataset [ 33 ] have provided a very solid foundation for how synthetic low-light images should be constructed: following a real-world dataset illumination distribution extracted from multiple datasets and delivering the result into an easy-to-use encoding format.
blocks.zh: 最近,随着LOL [32],LOL-v2 real [33],SDSD-in/out [34],以及LOL-Blur [35]等成对真实世界数据集的出现,数据限制问题得到了解决. 然而,另一个令人关切的领域是依赖合成低光度适应方法。 广泛运用的当前方法,如杨等人的工作. 通过其LOL-v2合成数据集[33]为合成低光图像的构建提供了非常坚实的基础:遵循从多个数据集提取的实时数据集照明分布,并将结果送入易于使用的编码格式.

blocks.en: 2.2 Low-Light Image Enhancement
blocks.zh: 2.2 低光图像增强

blocks.en: Classical Methods. LLIE has been firstly addressed using plain-enhancement [ 36 ] which focused mainly on histogram equalisation [ 37 ] and gamma correction [ 38 , 39 ] . These methods amplify the brightness and contrast of underexposed images through pixel intensity transformations. Because of the complex and uneven way illumination interacts with different areas from the image, these models struggled to model the light projection process, resulting in perceptually inconsistent outputs containing over-enhanced regions and amplified noise.
blocks.zh: 经典方法. LLIE首先采用纯增生[36]处理,主要侧重于直方图平化[37]和伽玛校正[38,39]. 这些方法通过像素强度的变换,扩大了曝光不足的图像的亮度和对比度. 由于照明与图像不同区域相互作用的方式复杂且不均匀,这些模型为模拟光投影过程而挣扎,导致透视不连贯的输出包含过度增强的区域和放大噪声.

blocks.en: The later introduced Retinex theory [ 40 ] aims to decompose the image in two components: reflectance, which represents the intrinsic scene information and illuminance, focusing on lighting variations. To better account for the illumination effects on the local and global structures, LLIE-methods have employed the theory as the underlying assumption behind the image architecture [ 41 , 42 , 43 ] . These models focused on estimating and refining the illumination map and reconstructing the image in a later stage with the more balanced and denoised reflectance map. This component-separation approach lead to more visually appealing and plausible results than the traditional enhancement techniques which rely heavily on hand-crafted priors and assumptions, making them hard to generalize across multiple datasets.
blocks.zh: 后来引入的Retinex理论[40]旨在将图像分解为两个部分:反射,代表内在的场景信息和亮度,专注于照明变异. 为了更好地说明对地方和全球结构的照明效应,LLIE方法将这一理论作为图像结构背后的基本假设[41、42、43]。 这些模型侧重于对照明图进行估计和精炼,并在后期用更加平衡和虚化的反射图重建图像. 这种组件分离方法比传统增强技术更具有视觉吸引力和合理性,这些技术严重依赖手工制作的前科和假设,很难在多个数据集中加以概括。

blocks.en: CNN-based Methods. Besides the improvements brought in language applications or high level CV tasks, the advancement of Deep Learning (DL) has also transformed the field of image enhancement becoming the dominant paradigm [ 14 , 44 , 45 ] . One of the earliest DL models on the scene of LLIE was LLNet [ 46 ] which proved that supervised feature learning can improve brightness and contrast while also recovering lost details. Generative models, like EnGAN [ 15 ] , focused on creating a direct mapping from low-light images to their enhanced counterparts by employing an end-to-end framework. These methods further improved upon traditional hand-crafted heuristic-based algorithms through hierarchical feature extraction.
blocks.zh: 基于CNN的方法. 除了语言应用带来的改进或高水平的CV任务之外,深层学习(DL)的推进也改变了图像增强领域成为主流范式[14,44,45]. LLIE现场最早的DL模型之一是LLNet[46],它证明了被监督的特性学习可以提高亮度和对比度,同时也可以恢复丢失的细节. 像EngAN [15] 这样的基因模型,通过使用端到端的框架,专注于创建从低光图像到其增强的对应物的直接映射. 这些方法通过分级特征提取,在传统手工的Heuristic算法上得到了进一步的改进.

blocks.en: The Retinex theory [ 40 ] is furthermore employed as an assumption, leveraging the ability of DL frameworks to learn feature decomposition. While such models, benefit from both physical priors and data-driven learning, they often require multi-stage training pipelines through subnetwork specialisation [ 42 ] on tasks such as: decomposition, illumination/reflectance enhancement, and reconstruction. As a result, the computational and training complexity of this kind of models are high. To solve this, one-stage Retinex-inspired Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) have also been proposed in order to increase the computational efficiency, but they struggle with noise mitigation and artifacts, resulting in an unsatisfactory enhancement process.
blocks.zh: Retinex理论[40]被进一步用作一种假设,利用DL框架学习特征分解的能力. 虽然这些模型既受益于物理前科,又受益于数据驱动的学习,但它们往往需要通过子网络专门化[42]的多阶段培训管道来完成诸如分解、照明/反射增强和重建等任务。 因此,这类模型的计算和培训复杂度很高. 为了解决这个问题,还提出了一个阶段的Retinex启发式革命神经网络(CNN),以提高计算效率,但它们与噪声减缓和文物纠缠在一起,导致提升过程不尽人意.

blocks.en: Another issue that CNN-based models exhibit is the limited receptive field of convolutional layers, hence reducing their ability to capture long-range spatial dependencies constructing the global contextual relationship across distant image regions. As light’s interaction with the scene is not linear, hence why histogram-matching models fail in the LLIE domain, this limitation restricts the models’ capacity of capturing diverse scene structures and mapping the relationships between them.
blocks.zh: 以CNN为基础的模型展示的另一个问题是可接受程度有限的演化层领域,从而削弱了它们捕捉远距离空间依赖性的能力,从而构建了跨越遥远图像区域的全球背景关系。 由于光线与场景的相互作用不是线性的,因此为什么直方图匹配模型在LIE域失败,这种限制限制了模型捕捉不同场景结构并绘制它们之间的关系图的能力.

blocks.en: ViT-based Methods. To overcome the inherent locality of convolutional operators, ViT-based models [ 27 , 47 ] have dominated the SOTA models charts for LLIE in the past years. The success achieved in machine translation by the Transformer architecture [ 48 ] , has also spread to CV and more specifically to image enhancement. The principal particularity that ViTs possess is the self-attention module which manages to capture long-range dependencies which guide the enhancement process towards a complex resolution of the LLIE challenge.
blocks.zh: 基于VIT的方法. 为了克服演化运营商的固有位置,基于VIT的模型[27,47]在过去几年里主导了LLIE的SOTA模型图表. 变形金刚架构在机器翻译上取得的成功[48],也传播到CV,更具体地说,传播到图像增强. ViTs拥有的主要特殊性是能够捕捉远程依赖的自我关注模块,它引导增强过程向LIE挑战的复杂解决方向发展.

blocks.en: Several architectures have marked the evolution of using ViTs [ 27 ] in LLIE. For example, UFormer [ 49 ] adapts the U-shaped [ 26 ] encoder-decoder paradigm, replacing the standard convolutions found in U-Net [ 26 ] with Transformer blocks while preserving level-wise skip connections. Retinexformer [ 50 ] incorporates illumination representations into the self-attention mechanism to model non-local interactions across regions with varying lighting conditions. More recent work, such as ISALux [ 51 ] or ModalFormer [ 52 ] , successfully manage to integrate semantic and structure priors into the self-attention module aiming to compensate the light-deficiency induced detail loss with visual or feature-based information represented through different modalities.
blocks.zh: 一些建筑标志着在LIE中使用ViTs[27]的演变. 例如,UFormer [49] 修改了U形 [26] 编码器-解码器范式,用变形器块取代了在U-Net [26] 中发现的标准变形器,同时保留水平跳过连接. Retinexformer [50] 将照明表示纳入自觉机制,以模拟不同照明条件的区域之间的非本地互动。 最近的工作,如ISALux [51] 或ModalFormer [52],成功地将语义学和结构学前科整合到自留心模块中,旨在用不同方式代表的视觉或基于特征的信息来补偿轻度引起的细节损失.

blocks.en: Despite their strong performance, Transformer-based methods face notable computational challenges. The self-attention mechanism incurs substantial computational complexity due to its reliance on the spatial dimensions of the feature maps. To mitigate this limitation, several methods, such as Restormer [ 53 ] , DepthLux [ 54 ] , employ different strategies: computing the attention map channel wise considering the depth of the feature map as the number of channels, contracting the feature space before the self-attention module and then expanding it back to its original dimensions, or replacing convolutions with their more efficient variation, depthwise separable convolutions.
blocks.zh: 尽管变形器方法的性能很强,但它们在计算方面面临显著的挑战。 自留心机制由于依赖于地物图的空间维度,因此在计算上相当复杂. 为了减轻这一限制,一些方法,例如Restormer [53],DepthLux [54],采用了不同的策略: 计算注意图通道 明智地将特征图的深度作为频道数量考虑,在自留心模块之前将特征空间收缩,然后将其扩展回原维度,或者用其更高效的变异来取代切变,深度可分化的切变.

blocks.en: RGB-Thermal Fusion for LLIE. RGB-Thermal fusion has recently been explored to enhance robustness in extreme low-light conditions by leveraging the illumination-invariant nature of thermal imagery. In particular, some studies [ 55 ] propose a thermal-aware ViT architecture, where thermal features are explicitly embedded into the transformer pipeline to guide global feature modeling under severe illumination degradation. Complementarily, Jha et al. focus on the interaction between illumination cues derived from the low-light RGB image and the corresponding thermal map, designing a mechanism that aligns and integrates these complementary representations for more stable enhancement [ 56 ] . These works demonstrate that modeling cross-modal dependencies, especially between illumination and thermal structure, can significantly improve detail recovery and perceptual consistency in challenging low-light scenarios.
blocks.zh: (原始内容存档于2017-03-27). RGB-热聚变LIE. 最近探索了RGB-热聚变,通过利用热成像的照明-变异性,在极低光条件下增强强性. 特别是,一些研究[55]提出了热感ViT架构,其中热特性明确嵌入变压器管道,以指导在严重照明退化下的全球特征模型. 补充,Jha等人著. 注重从低光度的RGB图像衍生出的照明提示与相应的热映射之间的相互作用,设计一种机制,使这些互补的表示值对齐并集成,以便更稳定的增强[56]. 这些著作表明,对跨模式依赖的模型,特别是照明和热结构之间的模型,可以在挑战低光度情景中大大改善细节回收和感知一致性.

blocks.en: 2.3 Modality Fusion for Image Semantic Segmentation
blocks.zh: 2.3 图像语义分裂的模态融合

blocks.en: Multi-modal semantic segmentation has emerged as an effective strategy for improving scene understanding and feature richness limitations under real-world conditions where RGB might be insufficient [ 57 ] . Complementary sensing modalities such as thermal (infrared) or depth maps have been included as inputs to improve the information representation of a specific scene [ 9 ] . Depth maps provide geometric and distance cues that can help disambiguate low-contrast regions and cluttered backgrounds [ 58 ] , while thermal images capture thermic distributions, offering a visual representation which is not subject to change under diverse light patterns or other deficiencies often noticed in nature like smoke or haze [ 20 ] . Semantic segmentation is not the only high-level CV task that has been benefiting from adding multi-modality in learning, with object detection, tracking, autonomous driving perception systems [ 59 ] also improving performance by leveraging multiple representations of the same scenes.
blocks.zh: 多式联运语义分割已成为提高场景理解的有效战略,在实际世界条件下,在RGB可能不够充分的情况下,具有丰富的局限性。 已将热(红外线)或深度图等补充感知模式作为投入,以改进特定场景的信息表现[9]。 深度图提供了几何和距离提示,可以帮助分解低混凝土区域和杂乱的背景[58],而热图像则能捕捉到热量分布,提供在不同的光线模式下不受变化的视觉表现,或者在自然界中经常注意到的其他缺陷如烟雾或雾霾[20]. 语义分解并非唯一一个在学习中加入多模式性而受益的高级CV任务,其对象检测,跟踪,自主驱动感知系统[59]也通过利用同一场景的多种表现来提高性能.

blocks.en: In the case of RGB-Depth semantic segmentation, early methods focused on fusing modalities at the input or feature level with some approaches directly concatenating RGB and depth maps or fusing them by summation [ 60 , 61 ] . In time, models have evolved to a two-stream architecture [ 4 ] , where independent networks extract features separately before integrating them in the decoding process. The recent focus has been placed on feature fusion approach which separates the fusion logic from the backbone and employing modules like Separation-and-Aggregation Gate [ 62 ] or Attention Complementary Modules [ 63 ] to provide parallel modality streams at each hierarchical level.
blocks.zh: 就RGB-深度语义分解而言,早期的方法侧重于输入或特征层次的引信方式,有些方法直接将RGB和深度地图调和,或通过归纳来进行引信[60,61]. 随着时间的推移,模型已经演化为双流架构[4],其中独立网络在将它们整合到解码过程之前会分别提取特征. 最近的重点是特征聚变方法,将聚变逻辑与主干分开,并采用分离和隔离门[62]或注意补充模块[63]等模块,在每个层次提供平行模式流.

blocks.en: A significant focal point of recent work is discriminative treatment of modalities [ 64 ] . This represents a change from the initial models which treated all network layers equally. More recent frameworks like LASNet [ 65 ] argue for level-specific treatment. This involves designing distinct models for different hierarchies: enhancing shallow spatial details (thermal-focused) and deep semantic features (RGB-focused) separately. Methods frequently integrate channel weighted selection and spatial-attention mechanisms to mitigate the inherent discrepancies (originating from distinct underlying data distributions) between modalities [ 44 ] .
blocks.zh: 最近工作的一个重要焦点是对模式的歧视性处理[64]。 这与对所有网络层一视同仁的初始模型不同。 较近期的框架,如LASNet[65] 主张按级别进行处理。 这涉及为不同的等级设计不同的模型:增强浅空细节(热聚焦)和深语义特征(RGB聚焦)的单独. 方法经常将信道加权选择和空间注意机制结合起来,以减少模式[44]之间的内在差异(源于不同的基础数据分布)。

blocks.en: The inherent limitations of CNNs, stemming from their constrained receptive fields, are also evident in modality fusion models. The Transformer architecture [ 27 ] has emerged as a compelling solution to this issue [ 66 ] . Driven by the capacity of the self-attention mechanism to model complex relationships across different contexts, current research is shifting from dedicated dual-modality models toward unified architectures. While earlier methods perform well on specific pairings like RGB-Depth or RGB-Thermal [ 67 ] , unified frameworks capable of integrating multiple concurrent data streams offer a much richer understanding of scene context, semantics, and structure. Consequently, these architectures yield superior performance on advanced scene understanding tasks.
blocks.zh: CNN的固有局限性源于其有限的可接受领域,在模式聚变模型中也很明显. 变形金刚架构[27]已出现,成为解决这一问题的有力解决方案[66]. 由于自留心机制在不同背景下建立复杂关系模型的能力,目前的研究正在从专门的双模式模式转向统一的架构。 虽然早期的方法在RGB-深度或RGB-热度等特定配对上表现良好[67],但能够整合多个并行数据流的统一框架提供了对场景背景,语义和结构的更丰富的了解. 因此,这些建筑在先进的场景理解任务上表现优异.

blocks.en: 3.1 Framework Design and Motivation
blocks.zh: 3.1 框架设计和动力

blocks.en: The framework behind VesperMUSE is based on three main components each having a dedicated role in the focus of this study: finding solutions for improving semantic segmentation under both low-light and well illuminated scenes.
blocks.zh: VesperMUSE背后的框架基于本研究重点各有专门作用的三个主要组成部分:在低光度和明亮度的场景下寻找改善语义分解的解决方案.

blocks.en: VesperMUSE can be run both in low-light or normal light configuration. If the latter is activated, then the framework starts from Stage 3 3 .
blocks.zh: VesperMUSE既可以低光运行,也可以正常的光配置. 如果启动后者,则框架从第3阶段开始。

blocks.en: Stage 1: Low-Light Synthetic Adaptation. The first step is obtaining the synthetic low-light imaging which will be processed using the algorithm presented in Section 3.2.1 . To link this framework as closely as possible to real world scenarios, the reasoning was physics-informed.
blocks.zh: 阶段1:低光合成适应. 第一步是获得合成低光成像,将使用第3.2.1节提出的算法进行处理。 为了将这一框架与现实世界的情景尽可能密切地联系起来,推理是在物理学知情的情况下进行的。

blocks.en: Stage 2: Low-Light Image Enhancement. After the low-light maps are processed they serve as inputs to the thermal-guided LLIE module described in Section 3.3 , along with the thermal imaging. The LLIE model is trained under a supervised approach trying to predict the original RGB map coming from the two focus datasets: PST900 [ 8 ] and CART [ 25 ] . The training and test splits are based on the ones used for the semantic segmentation stage. The result of the training process is the best checkpoint in terms of Peak-Signal-to-Noise-Ratio (PSNR), each dataset having its own selected checkpoint.
blocks.zh: 阶段2:低亮图像增强. 低光图处理后,它们与热成像一起作为第3.3节所述热导LLIE模块的投入。 LLIE模型是通过一个监督的方法培训的,试图预测来自两个焦点数据集的原始RGB地图:PST900 [8]和CART [25]. 训练与测试分拆是基于语义分化阶段所用的分拆. 培训过程的结果是,从峰-信号-对噪音-Ratio(PSNR)来说,是最佳的检查站,每个数据集都有自己选定的检查站。

blocks.en: Stage 3: Obtaining the Surface Normal maps. The RGB image (LLIE or not) serves as the input to the DepthAnything V2 [ 30 ] model, the resulting map being a monocular depth estimation. This representation is then used to produce surface normals by taking the gradients of it and thereby aiming to normalise the structural imagery.
blocks.zh: 第3阶段:获取地表正常地图。 RGB图像(LLIE与否)作为深度任意V2[30]模型的输入,由此产生的地图是单元深度估计. 然后利用这种表示方式,通过其梯度来产生表面正常性,从而实现结构图像的正常化。

blocks.en: Stage 4: Fusion-based Semantic Segmentation. The three inputs corresponding to the same scene: RGB, thermal, and surface normal are then passed to the Fusion Vision Transformer which processes each of them using a dedicated pre-trained backbone and then fuses them in a modality-agnostic manner. After the features have been fused, a decoding process commences processing the output of the framework, the segmented map. blocks.en: 3.2.1 Synthetic low-light adaptation algorithm

blocks.en: To show that semantic segmentation on low-light images can be improved using additional modalities, it required a robust real-environments informed synthesis pipeline. The current methods are limited in terms of: input data format (relying on the RAW format), noise modeling (linear noise used as implicit), global histogram matching (introducing unwanted artifacts, as colour and luminance information are not separated), and fixed parameter configuration (controlling environment variables is impossible).
blocks.zh: 为了表明使用其他模式可以改进低光图像上的语义分解,它需要一个健全的真实环境知情合成管道。 目前的方法有以下限制:输入数据格式(依赖RAW格式),噪声建模(用线性噪声作为隐含),全球直方图匹配(引入不想要的文物,因为色彩和亮度信息不分离),以及固定参数配置(控制环境变量是不可能的).

blocks.en: As a result, VesperMUSE framework proposes a novel pipeline for obtaining synthetic low-light images from RGB data. The algorithm aims to achieve a physics-informed degradation, accounting for the effect low-light conditions have on the visual representations.
blocks.zh: 因此,VesperMUSE框架提出了从RGB数据获取合成低光图像的新管道. 该算法旨在实现物理学知情的降解,核算低光条件对视觉表现的影响.

blocks.en: 3.2.2 Auxiliary modalities
blocks.zh: 3.2.2 辅助模式

blocks.en: VesperMUSE’s segmentation module works with three modalities: the main modality (well-lit RGB or LLIE map obtained with the algorithm presented in Section 3.2.1 and the thermal-guided enhancement model described in Section 3.3 ), and two auxiliary modalities: thermal and surface normal derived from the monocular depth map obtained from the main RGB modality.
blocks.zh: VesperMUSE的分区模块工作有三种模式:主要模式(用第3.2.1节介绍的算法获得的厚度RGB或LLIE地图和第3.3节描述的热导增强模型),以及两种辅助模式:从主要RGB模式获得的单光深图获得的热和表面正常.

blocks.en: Thermal. As previously discussed, the thermal modality provides enhanced robustness under varying illumination conditions. Furthermore, its effectiveness is largely attributed to the intrinsic physical properties it captures, namely the thermal inertia and emissivity of different materials and surfaces. These characteristics offer complementary information to the Fusion Vision Transformer, beyond what is available in the visible spectrum.
blocks.zh: 热. 如前所述,热能模式在不同的照明条件下提供更强的强度。 此外,其效力主要归功于它所捕获的内在物理性质,即不同材料和表面的热惯性和发射性。 这些特征为Fusion Vision Transformer提供了补充信息,超出了可见光谱中的现有信息.

blocks.en: In the PST900 dataset [ 8 ] , which depicts a subterranean environment with minimal heat sources, thermal imaging acts as a reliable structural cue, enabling the detection of humans even in the presence of obscurants. Conversely, in the CART dataset [ 25 ] , the thermal modality facilitates the discrimination of diverse textures commonly encountered in natural outdoor environments.
blocks.zh: 在PST900数据集[8]中,该数据集描绘了一种热源最小的地下环境,热成像起到可靠的结构提示作用,即使在有偏执者在场的情况下也能探测人类. 反之,在CART数据集[25]中,热模式有利于区分自然室外环境中常见的各种纹理。

blocks.en: Surface Normal. To better extract the context of the scene, a monocular depth map is extracted to highlight the structural and material differences between objects or surfaces. The noise and colour distortions, attenuated but still present in the enhanced RGB images and the thermal consistency of nearby objects in thermal maps might misguide the network in distinguishing edges and separation of entities. The first order gradients of the depth map are taken and turned into unit normal vectors to isolate and emphasize the geometric discontinuities where objects might protrude from their backgrounds. Furthermore, the scale-invariant representation of the geometric features provides the robustness needed in terms of the relative position of the objects to the camera, enabling a informative features extraction for close objects, as found in the PST900 dataset [ 8 ] , and distant objects as in the CART dataset [ 25 ] .
blocks.zh: 表面常态。 为了更好地提取场景的上下文,提取出单元深度图,以突出物体或表面之间的结构和物质差异. 噪音和颜色扭曲,在增强的RGB图像中减弱但仍然存在,以及热图中附近物体的热一致性,可能误导网络区分边缘和实体分离。 深度图的第一个顺序梯度被取而代之,变成单位正常向量,以隔离和强调物体可能从其背景延伸的几何不连续. 此外,几何特征的尺度变化表示提供了从物体相对于相机的相对位置来看所需的坚固性,从而能够对近物体进行信息化特征提取,如PST900数据集[8],远物体如CART数据集[25].

blocks.en:
Hybrid Loss. The LLIE objective is formulated as a weighted hybrid loss that jointly enforces pixel-level fidelity, perceptual realism, structural consistency, and semantic preservation.
Specifically, the loss combines:
(i) a Mean Absolute Error (MAE) reconstruction term to ensure and intensity correctness,
(ii) a perceptual loss computed in a pretrained feature space to enhance visual quality,
(iii) a structural similarity loss to preserve local structures, and
(iv) a semantic consistency term to maintain high-level content alignment with the ground truth, helping for the semantic focus required by the downstream semantic segmentation module.
The relative contribution of each component is controlled by weighting coefficients α 1 , α 2 , α 3 , \alpha_{1},\alpha_{2},\alpha_{3}, and α 4 \alpha_{4} .

具体而言,损失包括:
(一) 平均绝对错误(MAE)重建术语,以确保和强度正确;
(二) 为增强视觉质量,在预先训练过的特征空间中计算出的感知损失,
(三) 为维护当地结构而发生的结构相似性损失,以及
(四)语义一致性术语 保持高层次内容与地面真理的一致,帮助下游语义分区模块所需的语义焦点.

Semantic Consistency Loss. While the perceptual loss enforces similarity in a generic feature space to improve visual realism,
it does not explicitly guarantee preservation of task-relevant semantic content.
In LLIE, an approach which produces visually appealing images through contrast and colour balance amplification, does not imply that the model is optimized to enhance images for downstream tasks. Usually, it is quite the opposite as the type of visual composition which is appealing to the human eye is not informative enough for computer scene-understanding tasks such as semantic segmentation or object detection.

在LIE中,一种通过对比和色彩平衡放大来产生视觉吸引力图像的方法,并不意味着该模型被优化以加强下游任务的图像. 通常,它恰恰相反,因为吸引人眼的视觉组成类型对于计算机的场景理解任务,如语义分解或物体检测,信息不足。

blocks.en: Encoding Phase. The objective of the Fusion Vision Transformer is to effectively integrate an arbitrary number of input modalities, defined as a primary modality, M main M_{\text{main}} , and k ∈ ℕ k\in\mathbb{N} auxiliary modalities, M 1 , k ¯ M_{\overline{1,k}} .

blocks.en: The modality-agnostic nature of the architecture is enabled by the self-attention mechanism within the Fusion Encoder Block. This design effectively integrates global and local patterns from the auxiliary modalities while remaining inherently scalable. It accommodates an arbitrary number of inputs, without requiring structural modifications to the underlying fusion method.
blocks.zh: 该架构的模式不可知性是由Fusion Encoder Block内部的自觉机制所实现的. 这种设计有效地将全球模式和地方模式从辅助模式中整合起来,同时内在地保持可扩展性。 它容纳了任意数量的投入,不需要对基础聚变方法进行结构修改.

blocks.en: Features are processed using a encoder-decoder path, where the encoding process is conducted in 4 consecutive steps each of them being represented by the Fusion Encoding Block. The decoding process does not perform fusion as it process a single feature space originating from the end of the encoding stage.

blocks.en: Decoding Phase. The fusion mechanism of the proposed Fusion Vision Transformer is performed during the encoding stage, while the decoding stage is dedicated to feature refinement and coherence enhancement. The decoding process is structured around a series of blocks that progressively refine the representations across three hierarchical spatial levels. At each level, skip connections from the corresponding encoding stages are concatenated with the outputs of the decoding blocks. This design facilitates stable gradient propagation and mitigates the information bottleneck that typically arises when integrating heterogeneous visual modalities characterized by distinct underlying probability distributions.

blocks.en: 3.4.1 Fusion Encoder Block
blocks.zh: 3.4.1 组合编码器块

blocks.en: The Fusion Encoder Block represents the unitary component of the encoding stage of the Fusion Vision Transformer. Its role is to coherently combine the features originating from multiple modalities and to assess the unique information each one of them contains and how this information interacts with the other sets of specific data from the other modalities.
blocks.zh: Fusion Encoder Block代表了Fusion Vision Transformer的编码阶段的单元组件. 其作用是将多种模式产生的特征连贯地结合起来,并评估其中每一种模式所包含的独特信息,以及这些信息如何与来自其他模式的其他成套具体数据相互作用。

blocks.en: To achieve this, the Fusion Encoder Block employs 2 modules: the Fusion Self-Attention Module which combines and selects the most relevant features based on the current context and a FFN which further refines the fused maps. The modules interact through skip connection which aid the gradient flow and normalisation layers that provide data distribution unity across the samples.
blocks.zh: 为了实现这一目标,Fusion Encoder Block采用了2个模块:Fusion自留模块,它根据当前上下文结合和选择了最相关的特性,以及一个进一步改进了被引信的地图的FFN. 模块通过跳过连接进行互动,这些连接有助于提供整个样本的数据分布统一的梯度流和正常化层。

blocks.en: The principal advantage of the proposed Fusion Encoder Block lies in its structural scalability to an arbitrary number of modalities, k ∈ ℕ k\in\mathbb{N} . The only requirement is the designation of one modality as the primary modality, while the remaining k k modalities are treated as auxiliary. blocks.en: 3.4.2 Fusion Self-Attention Module
blocks.zh: 3.4.2 融合自留模块

blocks.en: The main constituent of Vision Transformers is the self-attention module which captures relevant features from the images, highlighting the prevalent information from the visual space. However, its effectiveness represents a compromise in terms of computational complexity with the standard vision self attention yielding a complexity of 𝒪 ⁡ ( H 2 ​ W 2 ) \mathcal{O}(H^{2}W^{2}) , where H H and W W represent the height and the width of the image. To partially mitigate this problem, the Fusion Self-Attention Module adheres to the solution proposed by Restormer [ 53 ] , where the attention scores produce a feature map in ℝ C × C \mathbb{R}^{C\times C} , hence the complexity of the the self-attention module becoming 𝒪 ⁡ ( H ​ W ​ C ) \mathcal{O}(HWC) , where C C represents the projection size of the Query ( Q Q ), Key ( K K ), and Value ( V V ) components.
blocks.zh: Vision Transformers的主要组成是自留心模块,它捕捉图像中的相关特征,突出视觉空间中普遍存在的信息. 然而,其有效性在计算复杂性上是一个折衷方案,标准视觉自我关注产生O →(H 2 W 2 )\ mathcal{O}(H^{2}W^{2})的复杂性,H和W W W代表图像的高度和宽度. 为了部分缓解这个问题,Fusion自留模块坚持Reformer[53]提出的解决方案,即注意力分数在R C × C → mathbb{R}^{C\times C}中生成一个特征图,因此自留模块的复杂性变成了O → (H W C)\ mathcal{O}(HWC),其中C代表了Query (Q), Key (K K),和 value (V V) 组件的投影大小.

blocks.en: Besides computational complexity, most self-attention modules fail to integrate both local and global features from the image, treating the projection of the images as a unitary feature. The accuracy of the down-stream task on which VesperMUSE focuses on, image semantic segmentation, heavily relies on local components such as edges, isolated illumination patterns, and noise. The proposed Fusion Self-Attention Module aims to achieve a both global and local feature extraction, which allows the model to adapt the latent representations considering a wider range of information.
blocks.zh: 除了计算复杂外,大多数自留心模块都未能从图像中整合局部和全局特征,将图像投影视为一个单一特征. VesperMUSE所关注的下游任务精度,图像语义分割,严重依赖边缘,孤立的照明图案,噪音等局部组件. 拟议的 " 融合自留 " 模块旨在实现全球和地方特征提取,使该模型能够考虑到更广泛的信息调整潜在表述。

blocks.en: 3.4.5 Segmentation Head
blocks.zh: 3.4.5 分部负责人

blocks.en: To map the high-dimensional fused representations extracted by the Fusion Vision Transformer into the distinct probability logits necessary for each class, a CNN is utilized.
blocks.zh: 为了将Fusion Vision Transformer所提取的高维线性表示物映射到每一类所必须的明显概率记录器上,采用了CNN.

blocks.en: Within the VesperMUSE architecture, the Segmentation Head utilizes a CNN to map the extracted feature representations into class logits, employing Batch-Normalisation (BN) to stabilize the activations. To act as a stochastic regularizer, a Dropout layer is strategically inserted between the two convolutional layers. By randomly zeroing hidden units during training, this layer prevents feature co-adaptation and forces the network to learn robust, distributed representations. Consequently, it mitigates overfitting to high-dimensional noise within the dense feature maps and ensures that the final pixel-wise classification generalizes effectively across diverse spatial contexts.
blocks.zh: 在VesperMUSE架构内,分块头利用CNN将提取的特征表示映射到类对数中,利用Batch-Normalisation(BN)稳定激活. 为了发挥调理调节器的作用,在两个演化层之间战略性地插入了Dropout层. 通过在训练中随机对隐藏单元进行零化,这层防止了特征共适应,迫使网络学习稳健,分布式的表示. 因此,它减轻了稠密的地物图中过于适合高维度的噪声,并确保最终的像素类分类在不同的空间背景下得到有效的概括.

blocks.en: The purpose of VesperMUSE’s proposed synthetic adaptation algorithm was to represent the synthetic low-light images as close to the real-world low-light imaging present in LOL-v1 [ 32 ] , LOL-v2-real [ 33 ] and LOL Blur [ 35 ] as well as improve on other methods which proposed synthetic adaptation methods such as LOL-v2-synthetic [ 33 ] .
blocks.zh: VesperMUSE提议的合成适应算法的目的是,将合成低光图像作为LOL-v1[32],LOL-v2-real[33]和LOL Blur[35]中真实存在的低光成像的近似物,并改进其他提出合成适应方法的方法,如LOL-v2-合成[33].

blocks.en: Illumination and Intensity. To accurately assess the perceptual quality and light profile from the synthetically adapted images, it is required to interpret the absolute intensity, the non-linearity in the captured illumination as well as uniformity of the light distribution. The Mean Luminance assesses the physical brightness in the scene which is observed to be low in the real world datasets LOL-v1 [ 32 ] ( 15.49 15.49 ) and LOL-v2-real [ 33 ] ( 16.08 16.08 ), but almost 4 4 times higher in LOL-v2-synthetic [ 33 ] ( 61.90 61.90 ). These values are strongly linked with the exposure which acts as a linear scalar multiplier for the incoming irradiance. The datasets obtained with the proposed method manage to share more similarity with the real-captured datasets in both mean luminance and exposure.
blocks.zh: 光辉和强烈。 为了从合成改编的图像中准确评估知觉质量和光线剖面,需要解释所捕获光线的绝对强度,非线性以及光线分布的统一性. 平均光度评估了在真实世界数据集LOL-v1 [32](15.49 15.49)和LOL-v2- real [33](16.08 16.08)中观察到的现场物理亮度,但LOL-v2-合成[33](61.90 61.90)中几乎高出4倍。 这些值与接触有着紧密的联系,而接触对即将到来的辐照具有线性分级乘数的作用。 采用拟议方法获得的数据集在平均亮度和暴露度两方面都能够与实际捕获的数据集分享更多的相似性。

blocks.en: Moreover, a critical flaw in earlier synthetic approaches, is the introduction of artificial non-linearity values, with Gamma being on average approximately 26 % 26\% higher than the values observed in real-world scenarios. In contrast, the proposed pipeline demonstrates a perfectly linear mapping, much closer to other low-light imaging datasets conditions.
blocks.zh: 此外,早期合成方法的一个重要缺陷是引入了人工非线性值,Gamma平均比现实世界情景中观察到的值高出约26% 26%。 与此相对照,拟议的管道显示完全线性绘图,更接近其他低光成像数据集的条件.

blocks.en: Noise. A well-known problem of light-deficient scenes is the presence of noise due to the reduced frequency of photons captured by the sensor. Therefore, an accurate noise modeling must always be linked with the level of illumination. The level of alignment with the real world datasets as well as the coherence of this correlation between the level of light and noise can be visualised in Figure 4.1 .
blocks.zh: 噪声。 光线不足的场景的一个众所周知的问题是,由于传感器捕捉到的光子的频率降低,噪音的存在. 因此,准确的噪声建模必须始终与照明水平联系起来. 与真实世界数据集的对齐程度以及光与噪声水平之间这种关联的一致性可以在图4.1中直观.

blocks.en: Figure 4.1 : Illumination vs. signal integrity. Real low-light data retain high SNR, while prior synthetic methods introduce excessive noise and over-brightening. VesperMUSE preserves an accurate signal quality similar to that observable in true low-light conditions.
blocks.zh: 图4.1:照明与信号完整性。 真实的低光数据保留了高的SNR,而之前的合成方法引入了过度噪音和过度震动. VesperMUSE保持了与真正低光条件下的可观测信号相似的准确信号质量.

blocks.en: Information preservation. Both local and global structural information is also lost when comparing a low-light image and its well-lit counterpart. The absence of light naturally introduces colour distortions and more weak edges which ultimately lead to overall information loss which is measured using the NMI. The two proposed datasets present the most important challenge in terms of the amount of information that needs to be recovered through the LLIE process, mainly when compared with the LOL-v2-synthetic [ 33 ] where the shared information is much higher between the low-light and normal light images ( 0.60 0.60 compared with 0.31 0.31 and 0.29 0.29 respectively).
blocks.zh: 资料保存。 在比较一个低光度图像和它的光亮良好的对应物时,也丢失了地方和全球结构信息。 光的缺乏自然地引入了色彩扭曲和更弱的边缘,最终导致使用NMI测量的整体信息损失. 两个拟议数据集在需要通过LLIE进程回收的信息量方面提出了最重要的挑战,主要是与LOL-v2-合成[33]相比,低光和正常光图像之间的共享信息要高得多(0.60 0.60,而分别为0.31 0.31和0.29 0.29).

Furthermore, the illumination has spatially and statistically a high variability, similar to the real-world environmental conditions.

blocks.en: 4.2.1 Quantitative Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.2.1 定量分析

blocks.en: Table 4.2 : Quantitative comparison of LLIE methods on the synthetically low-light adapted PST900 LL and CART LL datasets. Best results are highlighted in bold .
blocks.zh: 表4.2:合成低光度改造的PST900 LL和CART LL数据集上LLIE方法的定量比较. 最佳成果以黑体突出。

blocks.en: The quantitative results in Table 4.2 highlight several important points about the behaviour of thermal-assisted enhancement. An observation that needs to be made is that VesperMUSE LLIE is natively thermal-aware, while the other methods only aim to predict the well-lit images from the low-light maps only. ISALux [ 51 ] achieves the highest overall performance across both datasets, reaching 27.58 27.58 dB/ 0.874 0.874 (PSNR/SSIM) on PST900 LL and 27.81 27.81 dB/ 0.873 0.873 on CART LL, indicating strong reconstruction fidelity under purely RGB-based enhancement. However, VesperMUSE LLIE demonstrates highly competitive performance, attaining 27.47 27.47 dB/ 0.870 0.870 on PST900 LL and 27.74 27.74 dB/ 0.858 0.858 on CART LL, while maintaining a substantially lower parameter count of 0.454 0.454 M compared to 1.85 1.85 M. This corresponds to approximately a 4 × 4\times reduction in model size with only marginal degradation in PSNR ( ≤ 0.11 \leq 0.11 dB) and a limited drop in SSIM, particularly on PST900 LL.
blocks.zh: 表4.2中的定量结果突出了热辅助增强行为的几个要点。 需要观察的是,VesperMUSE LIE具有本土的热感知力,而其他方法仅着眼于预测低光度地图上的井光图像. ISALux [51]在两个数据集中实现了最高的整体性能,在PST900 LL上达到27.58 27.58 dB/0.874 0.874(PSNR/SSIM),在CART LL上达到27.81 27.81 dB/0.873 0.873,表明在纯粹基于RGB的增强下,重建忠心度很强. 然而,VesperMUSE LLIE表现出高度竞争性的表现,在PST900 LL上达到了27.47 27.47 dB/0.870 0.870,在CART LL上达到了27.74 27.74 dB/0.858 0.858,同时保持了0.454 045 M的参数数远低于1.85 M. 这相当于大约4×4\的模型大小缩小,在PSNR中只有边际降解(≤0.11\leq 0.11 dB)和SSIM的有限下降,特别是在PST900 LL上.

blocks.en: Compared to Retinexformer [ 50 ] , VesperMUSE LLIE consistently improves PSNR on both datasets (+ 0.87 0.87 dB on PST900 LL and + 0.63 0.63 dB on CART LL), while using approximately 3.5 × 3.5\times fewer parameters, highlighting a significantly better performance-to-complexity trade-off. Although Retinexformer [ 50 ] exhibits slightly higher SSIM on CART LL, but the gap remains small, suggesting that structural preservation is largely maintained by the proposed method.
blocks.zh: 与 Retinexformer [50] 相比, VesperMUSE LLIE在两个数据集上都不断改进PSNR(PST900 LL上+0.87 0.87 dB,CART LL上+0.63 0.63 dB),同时使用约3.5×3.5\x次的参数,突出表现与复杂度的权衡显著改善. 虽然Retinexformer[50]在CART LL上显示出略高的SSIM,但差距仍然很小,说明结构保存基本上由拟议方法维持.

blocks.en: Notably, the strong performance of VesperMUSE LLIE can be attributed to its thermal-aware design, which introduces complementary modality information that is particularly beneficial under challenging low-light conditions where RGB signals alone are not always stable and informative. This is especially evident on PST900 LL, where the gap to the top-performing method is minimal despite architectural differences and reduced model capacity. In contrast, LYT-Net [ 47 ] , while extremely lightweight ( 0.045 0.045 M parameters), suffers from a significant drop in both PSNR and SSIM, indicating that aggressive parameter reduction without multi-modal guidance limits restoration quality.
blocks.zh: 值得注意的是,VesperMUSE LLIE的强效性能可归因于其热感知设计,该设计引入了互补模式信息,在具有挑战性的低光条件下特别有益,因为单凭RGB信号并不总是稳定和信息化的. 这在PST900 LL上尤为明显,尽管建筑差异和模型容量下降,但与顶级性能方法的差距最小. 与此相反,LYT-Net [47]虽然极轻(0.045 0.045 M参数),但PSNR和SSIM均受到大幅下降的影响,这表明在没有多式联运制导的情况下主动减少参数会限制恢复质量。

blocks.en: 4.2.2 Qualitative Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.2.2 定性分析

blocks.en: The qualitative results further demonstrate the strong enhancement capability of VesperMUSE LLIE, particularly in approximating the RGB reference from severely degraded inputs. The proposed method produces outputs with improved local contrast and more accurate colour saturation compared to Retinexformer [ 50 ] and LYT-Net [ 47 ] , which tend to generate flatter or slightly desaturated images. Notably, chromatic fidelity is well preserved, as observed in the PST900 LL samples where objects such as the yellow helmet and red fire extinguisher are reconstructed with more natural and vivid colours.
blocks.zh: 质量结果进一步表明,VesperMUSE LLIE具有强大的增强能力,特别是从严重退化的投入中接近RGB的参考。 与 Retinexformer [50] 和 LYT-Net [47] 相比,拟议方法产生的产出会提高局部对比度和更准确的色彩饱和度,而LYT-Net [47] 往往会产生平淡或略不饱和的图像. 值得注意的是,色素忠贞性保存良好,在PST900 LL样本中观察到,黄头盔和红色灭火器等物体以更自然和更生动的颜色重建。

blocks.en: The benefits of the thermal-aware design are also evident in the preservation of structural details. In regions where the low-light RGB input lacks visible information, VesperMUSE LLIE effectively leverages thermal cues to enhance edge sharpness and suppress noise, leading to clearer object boundaries and more stable textures. While ISALux [ 51 ] achieves comparable visual quality, the proposed method delivers competitive results with a significantly lower computational footprint, avoiding common artifacts such as halos or over-smoothing.
blocks.zh: 热感知设计的好处在结构细节的保存中也很明显. 在低亮RGB输入缺乏可见信息的区域,VesperMUSE LIE有效地利用热提示来增强边缘锐度和抑制噪音,从而导致更清晰的物体边界和更稳定的纹理. 虽然ISALux [51] 实现了可比较的视觉质量,但拟议方法在计算足迹明显较低的情况下提供竞争性结果,避免了光圈或过度吸食等常见文物.

blocks.zh: 4.3.1 定量分析

blocks.en: PST900 Evaluation. While VesperMUSE achieves a highly competitive mIoU of 0.8559 0.8559 (trailing the leading CM-SSM [ 73 ] by a marginal 0.0031 0.0031 ), a closer examination of class-wise distributions reveals the distinct advantage of its tri-modal input architecture. Despite employing a comparatively standard ResNet50/18 [ 28 ] backbone ensemble, the model establishes new state-of-the-art thresholds for geometrically rigid, contextually isolated objects. It notably outperforms robust contemporary baselines, including SA-Gate [ 76 ] and CM-SSM [ 73 ] , on the Hand-Drill ( 0.8282 0.8282 ) and Fire-Extinguisher ( 0.8776 0.8776 ) classes by significant margins. This suggests that the inclusion of surface normal maps act as an informative structural guide, allowing the network to delineate sharp object boundaries even against methods utilizing substantially heavier feature extractors (e.g., LASNet’s ResNet-152 [ 28 ] ). Furthermore, the VesperMUSE LLIE configuration demonstrates remarkable robustness, achieving a strong 0.7818 0.7818 mIoU that remains highly competitive with established baselines such as EGFNet [ 77 ] . Therefore, it is shown that the pre-enhancement process aids semantic understanding through noise removal and colour shift correction (two essential components of low-light information recovery) while simultaneously producing visually appealing, illuminated feeds.
blocks.zh: PST900评价. 虽然VesperMUSE实现了0.8559 0.8559的高度竞争性mIoU(将领先的CM-SSM[73]乘以微弱的0.031 0.031),但更仔细地审查类分布,揭示了其三模式输入架构的显著优势. 尽管采用了比较标准的ResNet50/18[28]骨干组合,但该模型为几何刚性,上下文隔离的物体确定了新的最先进的阈值. 它明显超越了当代稳健的基线,包括SA-Gate[76]和CM-SSM[73],在手虾(0.8282 0.8282)和Fire-Extinguisher(0.8776 0.8776)两个类别上以相当大的边际。 这表明,列入表层正常地图可作为信息化的结构指南,使网络甚至能够对照使用重得多的特征提取器的方法(例如LASNet的ResNet-152[28])划定尖锐的物体界限。 此外,VesperMUSE LLIE的配置显示出显著的稳健性,实现了强大的0.7818 0.7818 mIoU,与EGFNet等既定基线保持高度竞争力[77]. 因此,显示前增强过程通过除噪和色移修正(低光信息恢复的两个基本组成部分)来帮助语义理解,同时产生具有视觉吸引力的照明素材。

blocks.en: CART Evaluation. VesperMUSE establishes a new state-of-the-art on the operationally complex CART dataset [ 25 ] , achieving an mIoU of 0.7672 0.7672 and decisively outperforming previous leading methods such as CM-SSM [ 73 ] ( 0.7460 0.7460 ) and CMX [ 9 ] ( 0.7400 0.7400 ). In contrast to PST900 [ 8 ] , CART [ 25 ] necessitates pronounced resilience to unstructured outdoor environments and highly variable terrain boundaries. The architecture’s efficacy on ground-level classifications (e.g., Bare Grd. at 0.8706 0.8706 compared to CM-SSM’s [ 73 ] 0.8260 0.8260 , and Road at 0.6538 0.6538 over CRM’s [ 82 ] 0.6160 0.6160 ) underscores the robust spatial synergy between thermal features and surface normals. This cross-modal integration effectively compensates for the severe degradation of visual texture typical of low-light outdoor scenes. Critically, VesperMUSE exhibits superior semantic preservation of dynamic obstacles, surpassing recent baselines like MCNet-T [ 83 ] on the highly challenging Person class ( 0.3426 0.3426 vs. 0.3150 0.3150 ) and providing a new best mIoU on Vehicles class with 0.6314 0.6314 . Conversely, while the VesperMUSE LLIE variant encounters challenges with fine-grained dynamic obstacles (most notably its inability to delineate the Person class ( 0.0000 0.0000 )), this explicit LLIE configuration offers two distinct operational advantages. As opposed to the fine-features constructed classes, the enhancement process successfully reconstructs macro-level environmental features, maintaining robust segmentation accuracy on foundational terrain classes such as Water ( 0.8996 0.8996 ) and Rocky Terr. ( 0.7891 0.7891 ).
blocks.zh: CART 翻译 评价。 VesperMUSE在操作复杂的CART数据集上建立了新的最新技术[25],实现了0.7672 0.7672的mIoU,并且决定性地优于以往的主要方法,如CM-SSM[73](0.7460 0.7460)和CMX[9](0.7400 0.7400),与PST900[8]相比,CART[25]需要显著地适应无结构的室外环境和高度多变的地形边界。 建筑对地面分类的功效(例如:Bare Grd.为0.8706 0.8706,而CM-SSM为[73]0.8260 0.8260,Road为0.6538 0.6538,而CRM为[82]0.6160 0.6160)强调了热特征和表面正常的强大空间协同效应。 这种跨模式融合有效地补偿了低光度室外场景典型的视觉纹理严重退化. 关键的是,VesperMUSE表现出对动态障碍的超强语义保护,在极具挑战性的人物类(0.3426 0.3426 vs. 0.3150 0.3150)上超过了MCNet-T[83]等近期基线,为车辆类提供了新的最佳mIoU,0.6314 0.6314. 相反,虽然VesperMUSE LLIE的变体遇到一些有细微的动态障碍的挑战(最显著的是它无法划分人物类(0.0000000)),但这种明确的LLIE配置提供了两个不同的操作优势. 与构造的精细地貌类不同,增强过程成功地重建了宏观层面的环境特征,在水(0.8996 0.8996)和洛基特尔(Locky Terr.)(0.7891 0.7891)等地基地形类上保持了坚固的分区精度.

blocks.en: 4.3.2 Qualitative Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.3.2 定性分析

blocks.en: PST900 Evaluation. VesperMUSE’s strong quantitative results in underground scenarios are reinforced by visual comparisons against HAFNet [ 87 ] , CRM-RGBTSeg [ 82 ] , CAINet [ 86 ] , and EAEFNet [ 11 ] . First, the standard VesperMUSE configuration consistently maintains crisp, accurate predictions for primary targets, such as humans and equipment. By effectively fusing thermal and RGB data, VesperMUSE isolates heat-emitting objects even in near-total darkness, avoiding the boundary fragmentation seen in baselines like CAINet [ 86 ] .
blocks.zh: PST900评价. 与HAFNet[87]、CRM-RGBTSeg[82]、CAINet[86]和EAEFNet[11]的视觉比较,加强了VesperMUSE在地下情景中的强量化结果。 第一,标准VesperMUSE配置始终保持对人和设备等主要目标的简洁准确的预测。 VesperMUSE通过有效引信热和RGB数据,甚至在近乎完全的黑暗中隔离出发热物体,避免了CAINet等基线中看到的边界破碎[86].

blocks.en: Furthermore, the VesperMUSE LLIE configuration demonstrates a distinct advantage in pitch-black environments. While the noise is still a very serious problem and some classes with objects covering a smaller surface get misclassified because of the low-level feature shift caused by low-light environments, the LLIE configuration manages to recover essential hidden structural details even when surrounded by heavy noise (the Survivor instance on the last column of Figure 4.6 ).
blocks.zh: 此外,VesperMUSE LLIE配置在投影黑环境中显示出显著优势. 虽然噪声仍然是一个非常严重的问题,有些有物体覆盖较小表面的类由于低光环境引起的低层特征转移而得到错误的分类,但LIE配置即使在被强烈噪声包围的情况下(图4.6最后一栏的幸存者实例)也设法恢复了必要的隐藏结构细节.

blocks.en: CART Evaluation. The strong quantitative performance on CART [ 25 ] is supported by VesperMUSE’s visually comparison against methods like SFAF-MA [ 88 ] , CMNext [ 85 ] , SGFNet [ 81 ] , CM-SSM [ 73 ] . A first observation would be that the proposed method manages to continuously maintain a prediction for larger objects and not predict other classes inside of them (this behaviour can be noticed for SFAF-MA [ 88 ] and CMNext [ 85 ] ).

blocks.zh: 4.4 计算性能

blocks.en: Although the multi-modal architecture of VesperMUSE inherently incurs a higher computational cost in terms of floating-point operations (FLOPs), it maintains a competitive parameter footprint relative to its performance capabilities. Specifically, VesperMUSE establishes a new SOTA on the CART dataset [ 25 ] with an mIoU of 0.767 0.767 , outperforming the previous leading method (CM-SSM [ 73 ] ) by a significant margin of 2.1 2.1 %. Furthermore, when compared to other larger architectures such as MCNet-T [ 83 ] , VesperMUSE delivers a 3.0 3.0 % absolute improvement in mIoU while utilizing approximately 19.3 19.3 million fewer parameters ( 180.45 180.45 M vs. 199.79 199.79 M). The primary sources of the increased computational demand are: the tri-input framework, which necessitates an additional backbone and a supplementary pathway through the encoder, and the integration of the DepthAnything V2 [ 30 ] model for monocular depth estimation, which alone accounts for 43 43 GFLOPs. Ultimately, this computational compromise represents a deliberate architectural trade-off through the explicit modeling of depth which provides critical geometric priors that justify the higher FLOPs count.
blocks.zh: 虽然VesperMUSE的多模式架构在浮动点操作(FLOPs)方面必然会产生更高的计算成本,但相对于其性能能力,它保持了竞争性参数足迹. 具体地说,VesperMUSE在CART数据集上建立了一个新的SOTA[25],mIoU为0.767 0.767,比以前的领先方法(CM-SSM[73])表现显著,差幅为2.1.2.1%。 此外,与MCNet-T[83]等其他更大的建筑相比,VesperMUSE在mIoU中提供了3.0%的绝对改进,同时使用了大约1930万个参数(180.45亿米对199.79亿米)。 计算需求增加的主要来源是:三输入框架,它需要通过编码器增加一个主干线和一条补充路径,以及整合单倍深度估计的深度V2[30]模型,单是这一模型就占43个GFLOP。 归根结底,这种计算折中方案是一种有意的建筑取舍,它通过明确的深度模型,提供了关键的几何前缀,可以证明较高的FLOP数是合理的。

blocks.en: 4.5.1 The effect of LLIE on Semantic Segmentation performance
blocks.zh: 4.5.1 国家 LLIE对语义分裂表现的影响

blocks.en: The LLIE process conducted before the segmentation in the low-light configuration of VesperMUSE is essential for recovering lost detail and removing the noise. In this section the effect of the enhancement will be thoroughly studied to determine what improvement it brings in the semantic segmentation process and if some classes can benefit more from LLIE.
blocks.zh: 在VesperMUSE低光配置中分解前进行的LLIE过程对于恢复丢失的细节和去除噪音至关重要. 在这一节中,将彻底研究增强的效果,以确定它给语义分解过程带来了什么改进,以及如果有些班级能够从LIE中获得更多的好处。

blocks.en: Figures 4.9 and 4.11 show that the RGB configuration of VesperMUSE dominates in terms of performance which is absolutely expected. The main focus point of this study is to see if under a tri-modal input setting with no prior enhancement for the RGB, the performance is decreasing.
blocks.zh: 图4.9和4.11显示,VesperMUSE的RGB配置在绝对预期的性能方面占主导地位。 本研究的主要焦点是看在三模式输入设置下,对RGB是否事先没有增强,性能是否在下降.

blocks.en: For the PST900 dataset [ 8 ] the overall dataset mIoU improvement is strongly influenced by the large performance differences on the Fire-Ext. and Survivor classes, while the Hand-Drill and Backpack classes show a slight performance decline. The differences, however, have a considerable offset in the magnitude. While for the Hand-Drill and Backpack classes it can be considered just a model or training particularity, it is not the same case for Fire-Ext. and Survivor . A good candidate explanation for this would be the common features shared by the two groups of classes. Survivor and Fire-Ext are represented using brighter colours and a larger surface covered by their instances, while Backpack and Hand-Drill often have less contrastive colours and definitely a smaller instance surface.
blocks.zh: 对于PST900数据集[8],总体数据集mIoU的改进受到Fire-Ext和Survivor类的较大性能差异的强烈影响,而Hand-Drill和Backpack类则显示略有性能下降. 然而,这些差异在很大程度上抵消了这一程度。 虽然对于手虾和背包课来说,它可以仅仅被视为一种模型或训练特殊性,但对于Fire-Ext.和Survivor来说则不同。 这方面的一个很好的候选解释是两个类别的共同特点。 Survivor和Fire-Ext的表示使用更亮的颜色,其实例覆盖了更大的表面,而Backpack和Hand-Drill的对比度往往较低,绝对是较小的实例表面.

blocks.en: 4.5.2 Modality choices and their rank
blocks.zh: 4.5.2 模式选择及其级别

blocks.en: The inputs of VesperMUSE can be configured in a large number of ways. Although the standard and recommended configuration is composed of three inputs: RGB, thermal, and surface normals, the model can be run using any number of modalities as inputs with very little changes as the Fusion Self-Attention was specifically designed to structurally support any number of modalities.
blocks.zh: VesperMUSE的输入可以大量配置. 虽然标准与推荐配置由三种输入组成:RGB,热,和表面常态,但该模型可以使用任何数量的模式作为输入运行,很少变化,因为Fusion自定义是专门用来在结构上支持任何数量的模式的.

blocks.en: The only constraint, however, is that one modality has to be declared as the main modality while the others are auxiliaries. The main modality is used as the main source of information in the encoding stage and also has a larger backbone responsible for extracting the features from it. In all the configurations presented until now, the main modality was the RGB (normal or synthetically low-light adapted and then enhanced), but the purpose of this ablation study is to show how the model behaves under different number of inputs and what are the effects of modifying the rank of the modalities.
blocks.zh: 然而,唯一的制约因素是必须宣布一种模式为主要模式,而其他模式为辅助模式。 主要方式作为编码阶段的主要信息来源,也有更大的骨干负责从中提取特征. 在至今提出的所有配置中,主要模式是RGB(通常或合成低光度调整后增强),但本次衰减研究的目的是显示模型在不同数量投入下的表现方式以及修改模式等级的效果是什么.

blocks.en: Table 4.6 presents different input configurations and provides evidence for why RGB was chosen as a primary modality even when running under a LLIE configuration and the enhanced images present noise and colour distortions, while the thermal is left unaffected. Furthermore, LLIE RGB is shown to also validate the primary modality advantage when interchangeably switched with the surface normal representations.
blocks.zh: 表4.6提供了不同的输入配置,并提供了证据,说明为什么即使在LLIE配置下运行时,RGB仍被选为主要模式,增强的图像呈现出噪声和色彩扭曲,而热量则不受影响. 此外,LLIE RGB在与表层正常表示可互换时也证明主要模式优势。

blocks.en: Thermal and Surface Normals as Auxiliaries. A first observation, as shown in Figure 1.1 , is that both modalities bring an important contribution if compared to the segmentation network using only the LLIE RGB as input. Their impact is very similar when individually employed, with an average of ≈ 3 % \approx 3\% performance deficit when the surface normal is not used and an average of ≈ 3.5 % \approx 3.5\% performance deficit considering both datasets. The combined benefit is observed mainly on the PST900 [ 8 ] dataset with an average improvement of ≈ 5 % \approx 5\% for both modalities, confirming again the fact that the CART dataset [ 25 ] provides more informativeness in its RGB maps than PST900 [ 8 ] because of the different light conditions.
blocks.zh: 热和表面常态作为辅助. 如图1.1所示,第一点意见是,如果与只使用LIE RGB作为输入的分区网络相比,这两种模式都带来重要的贡献。 其影响在个体就业时非常相似,在表面正常没有使用时,平均为 XXX 3%\ 大约为 XXX 3%的性能赤字,在两个数据集中,平均为 XXX 3.5%\ 大约为 3.5%的性能赤字。 综合效益主要在PST900 [8]数据集上观察到,两种模式的平均改进度为%\ 5%\ 约 5%,再次证实CART数据集[25]因其光线条件不同而在其RGB地图中提供了比PST900 [8]更丰富的信息.

blocks.en: The relevance of the RGB modality is again confirmed when comparing the two configurations where LLIE RGB and surface normal representations are switched so that each one is alternatively a main modality and an auxiliary. The results on both datasets show that there is an average of ≈ 7.0 % \approx 7.0\% performance deficit when the surface normal map is used as a main modality.
blocks.zh: 在比较LLIE RGB和表面正常表示转换的两种配置时,RGB模式的相关性再次得到确认,这样,每种配置要么是主要模式,要么是辅助。 两套数据集的结果显示,当表面正常地图作为主要模式使用时,平均有\\ 7.0%\\ 约 7.0\\ 性能不足.

blocks.en: Thermal as Main Modality. Given that this ablation study is conducted under low-light configuration, it would be expected for the thermal modality provide more information about the overall composition of the image, as it is not affected by noise, exposure and loss of global and local structures. However, a configuration with thermal used as a main modality, with surface normals, reflectance and illumination as auxiliaries shows a large performance decline compared to the other configurations where LLIE RGB is used as the main modality.
blocks.zh: 热是主运动。 鉴于这项减速研究是在低光度配置下进行的,预计热能模式将提供关于图像总体构成的更多信息,因为它不会受到噪音、暴露以及全球和地方结构损失的影响。 然而,以热为主要模式的配置,以表面常态,反射和照明为辅助,与以LIE RGB为主要模式的其他配置相比,显示性能大幅下降.

blocks.en: The reflectance and illuminance maps represent a decomposition of the LLIE RGB image conducted under the assumption of the Retinex Theory [ 40 ] which suggests that visual information can be separated into two core components: reflectance responsible for the colour information and illuminance encoding the intensity of the pixels.
blocks.zh: 反射和闪光图代表了在Retinex理论[40]的假设下进行的LLIE RGB图像的分解,它表明视觉信息可以被分离成两个核心组成部分:对色彩信息负责的反射和对像素强度的闪光编码.

blocks.en: The decomposition can be done using various ways, from classical to neural networks which are trained specifically for accurate representation of both components. However, for the purpose of this experiment, a simpler approach was used, where the illumination is considered as the maximum value across the channels and reflectance as the original image divided by the illumination, both filtered using, a Gaussian Kernel.
blocks.zh: 分解可以通过各种方式进行,从古典网络到神经网络,这些网络都经过专门培训,以准确反映两个组成部分。 然而,为了这个实验的目的,采用了一种更简单的方法,即将照明视为跨通道的最大值,并将反射视为被照明分裂的原始图像,两者都经过过滤使用,一个高斯克内尔.

blocks.en: 4.5.3 Architectural motivation
blocks.zh: 4.5.3 建筑动机

blocks.en: Impact of the Fusion Strategy. To motivate the design of the proposed Fusion Encoder Block, it is compared against a baseline strategy that relies on naive concatenation. In this baseline, multi-modal features are simply concatenated along the channel dimension prior to passing through a standard Transformer block. As shown in Table 4.7 , the proposed cross-attention fusion approach yields a substantial performance improvement, outperforming the concatenation baseline by ≈ 4 % \approx 4\% mIoU.
blocks.zh: 融合战略的影响。 为了激励拟议的融合编码器块的设计,它被比作依赖于天真的凝聚的基线策略. 在这个基线中,在通过标准变形器块之前,多式特性只是沿通道维度进行调整. 如表4.7所示,拟议的交叉注意力聚变方法产生了显著的性能改善,比交配基线提高了4%/大约4%/米乌。

blocks.en: This performance gap highlights the limitations of early concatenation. While concatenation aggregates multi-modal data into a unified tensor, it forces the subsequent layers to implicitly learn the cross-modal alignments from scratch without any structured guidance. In contrast, the proposed fusion mechanism explicitly models the spatial and semantic correlations between the primary and auxiliary modalities. By utilizing cross-attention, the network dynamically queries the auxiliary streams to enhance the primary features, ensuring that the model selectively attends to relevant multi-modal cues rather than treating all concatenated channels with equal initial weight.
blocks.zh: 这一性能差距凸显了早期凝聚的局限性. 虽然将多式联运数据汇总成一个统一的变压器,但它迫使随后各层在没有任何结构化指导的情况下从头开始隐含地学习跨模式对齐。 相比之下,拟议的聚变机制明确模拟了主模式和辅助模式之间的空间和语义相关性。 通过利用交叉注意力,网络动态地询问辅助流,以加强主要特征,确保该模型有选择地遵守相关的多式联运提示,而不是以相同的初始重量对待所有弯曲通道。

blocks.en: Replacing Decoders with Convolutions. As detailed in Section 3.4.4 , the core feature refinement component within the VesperMUSE decoder is a lightweight, attention-based Transformer block. This module is specifically designed to refine the multi-scale fused features, utilizing self-attention to dynamically weigh and prioritize spatial information that is most relevant to the current semantic context. To validate this design choice, an ablation study was conducted where these Transformer blocks were replaced with standard pointwise convolutions, effectively removing the global context-aggregation capabilities of the attention mechanism while maintaining a similar channel dimensionality.
blocks.zh: 用革命取代解码器 如第3.4.4节所详述,VesperMUSE解码器内的核心特性完善组件是一个轻量级,基于注意力的变形器块. 本单元专门设计是为了完善多尺度的引信特征,利用自我意识来动态地权衡和优先安排与当前语义背景最相关的空间信息。 为了验证这种设计选择,进行了一项膨胀研究,在这些变形器块被标准点向演化所取代,有效地消除了注意力机制的全局上下文聚合能力,同时保持了类似的通道维度.

blocks.en: Table 4.7 , shows that reverting to a purely convolutional decoder results in a measurable performance degradation, dropping the mIoU from 0.7818 0.7818 to 0.7351 0.7351 on PST900 [ 8 ] , and from 0.5957 0.5957 to 0.5320 0.5320 on CART [ 25 ] . While the convolutional substitution slightly reduces the total parameter count (from 180M to 179M), it increases the computational overhead (from 321G to 326G FLOPs). More importantly, the drop in segmentation accuracy confirms that the spatially-aware feature refinement provided by the Transformer block is crucial. The self-attention mechanism allows the network to effectively resolve local ambiguities by leveraging long-range dependencies, a capability that simple pointwise convolutions lack.
blocks.zh: 表4.7显示,恢复纯转录式解码器会导致可测量的性能退化,MIOU在PST900[8]上从0.7818 0.7818降至0.7351 0.7351,在CART[25]上从0.5957 0.5957降至0.53200.5320。 虽然顺式替代略微减少了总参数计数(从180M降至179M),但增加了计算间接费用(从321G增至326G FLOPs). 更重要的是,分化精度的下降证实了变形器块提供的空间感知特征改进至关重要. 自觉机制使网络能够通过利用远程依赖有效地解决局部模糊问题,这种能力简单指向演化不足。

blocks.en: 5.1 Known Limitations
blocks.zh: 5.1 已知的限制

blocks.en: Synthetic Low-Light Adaptation Algorithm Strong Degradation. In the current configuration, the main issue that is persistent within the low-light synthetic pipeline is that a small sample of the low-light samples are excessively degraded so that the LLIE module cannot recover lost information. The source of this issue remains unknown, however it is suspected that the issue comes from increasing the variability of illumination in the low-light conditions. As a result, a very few number of samples from the final light distribution are affected by this issue. Figure 5.1 presents a part of the affected samples with some managing to capture the overall structure of the image keeping some of the objects observable while others represent a totally noise and artifacts-covered representation which cannot be correctly evaluated by the segmentation module.
blocks.zh: 合成低光适应 算术强降解. 在目前的配置中,低光合成管道中持续存在的主要问题是低光样品的少量样本过度退化,使得LLIE模块无法恢复丢失的信息. 这一问题的来源仍然不明,但怀疑问题来自低光线条件下照明的变异性增加. 因此,最终的光线分布中极少数样本受到这个问题的影响. 图5.1列示了受影响样品的一部分,一些样本设法捕捉图像的整体结构,使一些物体能够观察,而另一些则代表了完全噪音和被文物覆盖的表示,分块模块无法正确评价。

blocks.zh: 解决这个问题的办法要么是去除受影响的样品,要么是进一步调整合成低光度适应算法,以诊断有问题的情况,提高照明阈值,同时使噪音水平低于其他样品。

blocks.en: LLIE module Output Colour Imbalance. A comparative analysis of the global intensity distributions (Figure 5.2 ) reveals that the LLIE module introduces luminance-dependent chromatic aberrations via non-linear channel uncoupling. Specifically, in the shadow and mid-tone regimes ( 0 ≤ I ≤ 150 0\leq I\leq 150 ), the model disproportionately attenuates the blue channel relative to the source distribution, inducing an unnatural warm colour cast. Conversely, in the extreme highlight regime ( I → 255 I\to 255 ), the output exhibits anomalous green-channel clipping, with saturation peaks significantly exceeding both the original image limits and concurrent RGB channels. This divergent colour distortion fundamentally disrupts the intrinsic RGB ratios across the dynamic range, highlighting a deficiency in colour constancy and necessitating the integration of cross-channel coupled tone mapping.
blocks.zh: LLIE模块输出色彩平衡. 对全球强度分布的比较分析(图5.2)显示,LLIE模块通过非线性通道不连接引入了依赖亮度的色调偏差. 具体地说,在阴影和中调制度(0 ≤ I ≤ 150 0\leq I\leq 150)中,该型号相对于源位分布过度减弱蓝色通道,诱发一种不自然的温暖色彩的铸造. 反之,在极亮度制度(I → 255 I\to 255)中,输出显示反常的绿色通道剪接,饱和峰明显超过原始图像限制和同时存在的RGB通道. 这种不同颜色的扭曲从根本上扰乱了整个动态范围的内在RGB比率,凸显了色彩坚韧性的不足,并需要整合跨通道组合调图。

blocks.en: Since the current loss function configuration does not have a colour loss integrated, this would strongly benefit the reduction of channel-based colour discrepancies between the well-lit images and the predicted maps from the LLIE module. In this case, the loss function would receive a new term, namely a colour-focused loss.
blocks.zh: 由于当前丢失函数配置没有集成的失色功能,这将极大地有利于降低LLIE模块中井字图像与预测地图之间的基于通道的色彩差异. 在这种情况下,损失功能将获得一个新的术语,即注重颜色的损失。

blocks.en: Fusion Vision Transformer Computational Requirements. Currently, as the focus of this work was not directly placed on computational complexity, the computational requirements needed to perform training and inference are high. An analysis of the comparative performance plot reveals distinct trade-offs between model accuracy and computational complexity. VesperMUSE demonstrates the highest performance among the evaluated models, achieving a peak mIoU of 0.7670 0.7670 on the CART dataset [ 25 ] . However, this superior accuracy incurs a higher computational cost relative to the baselines. Conversely, CM-SSM [ 73 ] emerges as a highly efficient alternative, delivering competitive accuracy (mIoU ≈ \approx 0.7460 0.7460 ) while maintaining a significantly lower computational footprint. Overall, while VesperMUSE establishes a new performance ceiling and strictly dominates heavier baselines like MCNet-T [ 83 ] , models such as CM-SSM [ 73 ] provide an optimal balance for resource-constrained applications.
blocks.zh: Fusion Vision变形器计算要求. 目前,由于这项工作的重点并不直接放在计算的复杂性上,因此开展培训和推论所需的计算要求很高。 对比较性能图的分析显示,模型精确度和计算复杂性之间有不同的权衡。 VesperMUSE在被评价的模型中表现出了最高的性能,在CART数据集上达到峰值mIoU0.76700.7670[25]. 然而,这种精度优于基线的计算成本较高。 反之,CM-SSM[73]作为一个高效的替代品出现,提供竞争性精确度(mIoU ≈\约0.7460 0.7460),同时保持显著较低的计算足迹. 总体而言,虽然VesperMUSE设定了新的性能上限,并严格控制MCNet-T[83]等较重的基线,但CM-SSM[73]等模型为受资源限制的应用提供了最佳平衡.

blocks.en: Besides architectural changes such as backbone change, lowering the projections sizes in the decoder path of the Fusion Vision Transformer or even modality-based pruning (only if two or more features have a high feature similarity), other inference methods like mixed precision (fp16), quantisation (by reducing the precision of the weights to a smaller container like int8/int16) can be taken into account for both the LLIE and semantic segmentation modules.
blocks.zh: 除了骨干变化等建筑变化外,降低Fusion Vision Transformer的解码器路径中的预测尺寸,甚至基于模式的推算(只有在两个或两个以上特征具有高度相似性的情况下),其他推论方法如混合精度(fp16),量子化(通过将重量的精度降低到像int8/int16这样的更小的容器)都可以考虑LLIE和语义分割模块.

blocks.en: 5.2 Future Work
blocks.zh: 5.2 未来工作

blocks.en: The subsequent development of VesperMUSE should primarily target both performance enhancement and the reduction of computational complexity. At present, further improvements in performance can be facilitated by adopting more efficient backbone architectures, potentially surpassing those derived from the ResNet family. Additionally, the utilization of modality-specific backbones for thermal and structural inputs represents a promising direction, as these are expected to outperform the current convolutional adaptation strategy employed within the model.
blocks.zh: 随后的VesperMUSE的发展应主要针对性能增强和计算复杂性的降低. 目前,通过采用效率更高的骨干结构,有可能超越ResNet家族的骨干结构,可以促进业绩的进一步改善。 此外,利用特定模式的骨干进行热和结构投入是一个有希望的方向,因为预计这些骨干将比模型中采用的现有逐步适应战略有所改进。

blocks.en: Furthermore, it is worthwhile to investigate alternative representations of image information, such as operating in different colour spaces or explicitly decomposing the input into low- and high-frequency components within the LLIE module. Such approaches may enable a more principled treatment of light irradiation, which has been shown to be an effective strategy in LLIE tasks.
blocks.zh: 此外,值得调查图像信息的其他表达方式,例如在不同颜色空间运行,或明确将输入分解为LIE模块内的低频和高频组件。 这种办法可以使光辐照问题得到更有原则的处理,而光辐照已被证明是LIE任务中的一个有效战略。

blocks.en: 5.3 Final Thoughts
blocks.zh: 5.3 最后想法

blocks.en: The proposed framework is intended to establish a foundation for future advancements in semantic segmentation under challenging and highly variable illumination conditions. Despite recent progress, the field continues to be constrained by the limited availability of diverse and representative datasets, which significantly hinders the development of robust and generalizable methods.
blocks.zh: 拟议框架旨在为今后在富有挑战性和高度可变性的照明条件下在语义分类方面取得进展奠定基础。 尽管最近取得了进展,但外地继续受到各种有代表性的数据集有限的限制,这严重阻碍了有力和通用方法的发展。

blocks.en: The scenarios explored in this study reflect realistic and often critical environments, including safety-sensitive missions where reliability is paramount. In such contexts, the deployment of models that are not only performant but also transparent with respect to their limitations becomes essential. This is particularly relevant for applications such as survivor identification, where the consequences of failure are profound. Therefore, advancing DL-based approaches in this domain is not solely a matter of improving accuracy, but also of fostering trust, robustness, and accountability in systems designed to operate under uncertainty.
blocks.zh: 本研究所探讨的情景反映了现实的、往往是关键的环境,包括可靠性至高的安全敏感飞行任务。 在这种情况下,必须采用不仅能发挥作用而且能透明地限制其局限性的模式。 这对于诸如幸存者身份鉴定等应用特别相关,因为失败的后果是深远的。 因此,在这一领域推进基于DL的方法不仅仅是一个提高准确性的问题,而且还是一个在为在不确定情况下运作的系统中促进信任、稳健和问责制的问题。
